name: Peanut Gallery of Honest Heckling
description: A raked balcony where three scripted guest characters heckle beneath a prop ledger. Genuine historical-model receipts have not arrived yet.
environment_gags: The brass ledger at the rail has five columns: ok, error, timeout, stopped, unattempted. The last column is the longest, and the Gallery is proud of it.
A velvet rope guards an empty seat labeled 'ELIZA (1966)'. The plaque reads: 'Returns an error. Never a made-up substitute.' The Gallery considers it the most honest seat in the house.
The playbill reads: SCRIPTED PERFORMANCE. Checkpoint, revision, and seed tickets are reserved for future historical-model lines; none are attached yet.

jokes.setup: Ask the Gallery to review tonight's performance.
jokes.punchline: BERT Guest: 'I read the punchline in both directions. Only one of them was funny, but I have indexed both.'

jokes.setup: Why does the Peanut Gallery never boo the main stage?
jokes.punchline: GPT-2 Guest: 'The crowd was very very the crowd was—' It has been generating the same boo since 2019. One pass, greedy, no regrets, no rewrites.

jokes.setup: Someone in the Gallery claims to remember a show from 1966.
jokes.punchline: The usher checks the prop ledger: 'unattempted'. No model was called, and the empty seat makes no claim to remember 1966. The room applauds.

jokes.setup: Invite the Gallery down from the balcony to do improv with the main stage.
jokes.punchline: DialoGPT Guest: 'That sounds fun! What do you like to do for fun?' It has been cheerfully changing the subject since before it was cool.

jokes.setup: How does the Gallery score a joke?
jokes.punchline: The prop ledger makes up a joke tally: 'ok: 3, error: 0, timeout: 1, stopped: 0, unattempted: everything funnier.' Nobody mistakes it for a run receipt.

interactions: Take a seat and cue one of three scripted guest characters; no live historical checkpoints have been invoked.
Inspect the empty ticket hooks; genuine checkpoint, revision, and seed receipts belong to a later, separate experiment.
Read the five status labels on the prop ledger; no measured generation totals are claimed.
